article.title: Defend Cuba and Demand the Lifting of the U.S. Energy Blockade and Embargo
article.author: Rémy Herrera
article.content: The current energy blockade deprives the Cuban people of resources essential for their survival. It must end immediately and unconditionally. The post Defend Cuba and Demand the Lifting of the U.S. Energy Blockade and Embargo appeared first on MR Online .
